blocks.text: Apartment interior design project in Dubai, UAE, 160 m²

parts.html: In this project, the DUMSKAYA DESIGN interior design studio (Bratislava, Slovakia) delivered a full scope of work: developing the interior design project, manufacturing custom furniture, and carrying out a turnkey renovation.

The interior covered every area of the Dubai apartment: the living room, bedroom, kitchen with custom interior fittings and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, bathroom, cabinets, and shelving. Bespoke furniture was designed for each area, tailored to the client’s needs and the architecture of the space.
Before work began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing work, custom furniture, home appliances, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and more.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations of the property are presented.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) successfully delivers projects not only in Slovakia but also beyond its borders, including in Dubai. We work with clients across Europe and the Middle East, offering a full cycle of interior design and implementation services.
